digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow and test infrastructure
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs on stale Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 froze at 99% progress for 1.7–4.3 hours without a job-level timeout bound, requiring manual cancellation to clear the worker queue.

The primary mechanism is the per-blob lazy-fetch defect (omitted commit 96a0d5c3f) causing sequential git-fetch RPCs for each of ~40 missing blobs on a blobless clone, projecting ~2.1 hours total latency.

Secondary defect: .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml test job lacks timeout-minutes configuration, defaulting to GitHub's 360-minute limit and preventing automatic failure recovery; setting timeout-minutes: 60 bounds the job within observed healthy performance (4–15 minutes) while preserving a 3x safety margin.

The test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract test in Gerrit 1129 PS3 hung due to FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignoring startAt/maxResults pagination arguments, causing an infinite loop; slicing the returned issue list per the pagination contract fixed the timeout.
Job-level timeout configuration must be added to the reusable workflow to prevent future stalled worker dependencies and manual-clear incidents even after upstream blob-fetch defects are repaired.
